qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Digital-first pan-European banking scale enables a superior cost-to-income ratio compared to traditional branch networks, but core products remain commoditized and rate-cyclical.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 10, REJECT). Branchless digital banking cost advantage is eroding as incumbent peers close branches and neo-banks (Revolut, N26, Bunq) commoditize digital deposits. Group earnings are over 75% dependent on rate-sensitive Net Interest Income (NII), failing the 15-year secular resilience test.
qualitative.evidence: ING Groep serves ~38M retail and wholesale customers across the Benelux and Germany. However, revenue is structurally dominated by net interest margins which collapsed during the ECB's negative interest rate era (2014-2022). With zero-cost digital deposit switching and aggressive neo-bank competition, competitive advantage persistence cannot be underwritten for 15+ years.
